title: Estimated weekly human microplastic intake vs a credit card's weight

source.name: No Plastic in Nature: Assessing Plastic Ingestion From Nature to People
source.publisher: University of Newcastle, commissioned by WWF

notes: A widely-cited 2019 estimate put average human microplastic ingestion (from food, water, and air) at approximately 5 grams per week, comparable to the weight of a standard credit card (about 5 grams), shown here as the baseline reference.
